description: Use when an agent needs a Solana token's basics before quoting, transferring or accepting it. Input: mint. Output: JSON slot, program (spl-token or token-2022), decimals, supply raw and decimal, mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, default frozen, metadata), known issuer if curated. Not a mint: 422, unknown: 404, not charged. Example: ?mint=EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

mint.description: Token mint address on Solana mainnet (base58, 32 bytes). Bad input → 400, not a mint → 422 (not charged)

name: sol_token_info
title: Solana token info: SPL / Token-2022 mint supply, decimals, authorities and extensions
